goal.objective: Move Healer cadence and cross-repository maintenance execution from token-bearing GitHub workflow dispatch to the single resident heartbeat using fixed local handlers and TV/TVC credential/admission authority.
success_predicates: No production scheduler path requires HEALER_GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, HEALER_PAT or GH_STEGVERSE_AI_TOKEN.
The resident heartbeat invokes the Healer scheduler only against already materialized repository roots.
Only fixed handlers compiled into StegVerse-Healer source may execute.
SCW org-scan and uptime can execute locally without GitHub credentials.
Missing local repositories or missing target adapters fail closed.
A no-secret scheduler receipt is persisted.
failure_predicates: GitHub workflow dispatch remains a production scheduling dependency.
A GitHub credential is accepted by the sovereign worker.
A target record injects an arbitrary command.
Missing target capability is silently treated as success.

task.derivation_reason: The prior Healer scheduler used HEALER_GH_TOKEN and GitHub workflow-dispatch as production transport, contrary to the TV/TVC authority boundary.

activation.recheck_trigger: each admitted heartbeat according to Healer target cadence while any target is due or blocked

completion.next_authorized_action: Run the heartbeat-owned scheduler against locally materialized Healer/SCW/Site/TV/Continuity trees; complete the remaining TV mutation and Continuity guardian no-token adapters without restoring GitHub credential transport.
terminal_when: No forbidden GitHub credential is present
All due targets have COMPLETE or explicitly terminal superseded outcomes
No target depends on GitHub workflow-dispatch as production transport
